# Acme Analytics Master Services Agreement

## Agreement Identity

Agreement ID: MSA-ACME-2026

Effective Date: 2026-02-01

Customer: Acme Analytics, Inc.

Provider: Northwind Data LLC

This agreement governs hosted data-processing services ordered under statements of work signed by both parties.

## Term and Renewal

The initial term is twenty-four months from the Effective Date.

The agreement renews for successive twelve-month renewal terms unless either party gives written non-renewal notice at least 45 days before the end of the then-current term.

## Termination for Cause

Either party may terminate this agreement for material breach if the breaching party fails to cure the breach within 30 days after written notice.

The Customer may terminate immediately if the Provider suffers a data security incident caused by Provider's willful misconduct or gross negligence.

## Termination for Convenience

The Customer may terminate an active statement of work for convenience after the first twelve months of that statement of work by giving 60 days' written notice.

The Provider may suspend services for undisputed unpaid fees after 15 days' written notice, but suspension is not a termination for convenience right.

## Notices

All notices under this agreement must be sent by email and nationally recognized overnight courier to the notice contacts listed in the applicable order form.

Termination and non-renewal notices are effective only when received.

## Confidentiality

Each party may use Confidential Information only to perform or receive services under this agreement.

Confidential Information must be protected using at least reasonable care and no less than the care used for the receiving party's own similar information.

Confidentiality obligations survive for five years after termination, except trade secrets remain protected for as long as they qualify as trade secrets under applicable law.

Upon termination, each party must return or destroy Confidential Information within 30 days after written request.

## Indemnification

The Provider will defend and indemnify the Customer against third-party claims alleging that the hosted service infringes a United States patent, copyright, or trademark.

The Provider will also indemnify the Customer for third-party property damage or bodily injury caused by Provider personnel while performing onsite services.

The Customer will indemnify the Provider for claims arising from Customer Data supplied in violation of law.

## Limitation of Liability

Except for excluded claims, each party's aggregate liability is capped at the fees paid or payable under the affected statement of work during the twelve months before the event giving rise to the claim.

The liability cap does not apply to payment obligations, confidentiality breaches, indemnification obligations, intentional misconduct, or unauthorized use of the other party's intellectual property.

## Insurance

The Provider must maintain commercial general liability coverage of at least $2,000,000 per occurrence.

The Provider must maintain cyber liability coverage of at least $5,000,000 per claim.

No professional liability or errors-and-omissions coverage is listed in this agreement.

## Assignment

Neither party may assign this agreement without the other party's prior written consent.

Either party may assign this agreement without consent in connection with a merger, reorganization, or sale of substantially all assets if the assignee assumes all obligations in writing.

Any prohibited assignment is void.

## Warranty Disclaimer

Except for express warranties in a signed statement of work, the services are provided without implied warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, or non-infringement.
